dedupe_keys.name: world nuclear association reactor database operable under construction and planned reactors worldwide

description: The Reactor Database of the World Nuclear Association is a free online database of nuclear power reactors worldwide with a global dashboard and search by country. On the day of cataloguing the dashboard showed 441 operable reactors with 404,127 MWe net capacity, 80 reactors under construction with 79,327 MWe, and a 9 percent share of global electricity generation (2,667,383 GWh in 2024), with top-ten capacity charts, generation by year and lists of the most recent grid connections and construction starts, the latest being Zhaoyuan 2 in China on 5 September 2026. The recent lists give each reactor name, model, reactor process, net capacity, grid connection or construction start date and location, and countries from Argentina to the United States can be browsed. Coverage is global. Access is free on the web; the pages read state no data licence or bulk download, so reuse beyond viewing needs permission. Caveats: figures can differ from the IAEA PRIS system. Simulation uses are current and planned nuclear fleet inventories for capacity and exposure studies. Related records: data-iaea-pris-power-reactor-information-system is the IAEA reactor database, and data-nrc-datasets-us-nuclear-facilities covers US regulator tables.
